source.title: Gold-Plated Blade — original item-side Wowhead Looter Disenchanted table raw HTML
source.author: Wowhead Looter (anonymous pooled client observations)

notes: Original Wowhead item 233538 raw HTML (Disenchanted tab, WH.TERMS.itemdisenchanted_format) reports 188 item-side disenchants and Storm Dust item 219946 row with count=51, outof=188, stack=[1,3], pctstack={1:31.3725,2:35.2941,3:33.3333}. Given exactly 51 observed positive Storm Dust outcomes, the source's rounded conditional stack percentages uniquely correspond to 16 single-unit, 18 double-unit and 17 triple-unit outcomes (16+18+17=51); total units = 16+36+51=103. The 137 zero bin refers ONLY to Storm Dust rank 1 absent from 137 item disenchant outcomes, not a disenchant producing zero materials. Distinct original item-side cumulative Looter cohort; source is reference-only because sample epoch/build, item variation/bonus, ilvl at processing, skill/spec, actual account, other per-cast output correlations and current Retail eligibility are unreported. No post-hotfix inference, gold EV, independent controlled cohort, or inferred other-material zero.
